description: Shared defaults: a 7-day wait before any release is proposed, one grouped non-major PR a week that merges itself on green CI, majors held for review, security fixes without the wait.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the wait and the weekly schedule. Whether they merge themselves is left to packageRules, so a repo that holds automerge holds these too.

packageRules.description: config:recommended adds security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (3 days for npm), which would override the 7 days above.
Non-major updates: one PR per repo per week, merged when every check passes. Renovate does not automerge a branch with no checks.
Below 1.0 a minor release may break: it still joins the group but stops the group merging itself.
Majors get their own PR and wait for review.
